learning_outcomes.text: Harmonious combination of physical education and sports with intellectual activity
Adaptation for systematic independent practice of physical exercise
Formation of discipline, punctuality, correctness, fair-play habits
Maintaining an optimal state of health
Development and education of basic and specific motor qualities
Formation of the capacity and habit of systematic, correct, and conscious practice of sport, implicitly physical exercise

Determination of the efficiency index (motor skills specific to the discipline - football, development of personality traits, elements of organizing motor activities, elements of physical development, etc.)

assessment_rules: To pass the course, students must demonstrate the ability to execute simple technical exercises/procedures in football. Active presence in classes, with a minimum of 7 lessons per semester, is also required.
